title: Finite flat duality with an invertible target
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be a finite [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism] flat [def-weil-flat-morphism] morphism of Noetherian schemes and let $L$ be an invertible $\mathcal O_Y$-module [def-sc-invertible-module]. Write $f^!L$ for the right adjoint image of $L$ under $Rf_*$ [def-pc-derived-direct-image]; it is a sheaf in degree zero. There is a canonical $f_*\mathcal O_X$-linear isomorphism $\Phi:f_*f^!L\cong\mathcal H om_{\mathcal O_Y}(f_*\mathcal O_X,L)$, where $f_*\mathcal O_X$ acts on the right by precomposition with multiplication. Under this isomorphism the adjunction counit $f_*f^!L\to L$ is evaluation at $1$, and for every local section $a$ of $f_*\mathcal O_X$ and $\omega$ of $f_*f^!L$ one has $\Phi(\omega)(a)=\Phi(a\omega)(1)$.

source.place: Tag 0BVI, Lemma 49.15.2 (finite flat case), and Tag 0FKW, Section 49.5 (evaluation and invertible target)

proof.text: The Noetherian finite-type finite-presentation Mathlib instance and isFiniteLocallyFree_pushforward_unit give finite local freeness of A=f_* O_X. The instance uses Algebra.FinitePresentation.of_finiteType, the existing finite-presentation node.

Choose the standard derived category for A-modules. The proved finiteRestriction_derived_rightAdjoint supplies rhoR and adjA. K is bounded below because K is isomorphic to L[0]. Apply finite_duality_derived_hom and compose inverse cA, restriction of phi and d to get Rf_*aK isomorphic to RHom(A,K).

Map eL through RHom and compose with finiteLocallyFree_derivedInternalHom_single. This represents Rf_*aK by Hom(A,L)[0]. The functor comparison identifies this with R(aK). Apply H0 and singleFunctorCompHomologyFunctorIso: because R(aK) is in D_QCoh, Hom(A,L) is quasi-coherent.

Apply affine_derived_concentration backwards to aK and the preceding quasi-coherent representative. Obtain M, its quasi-coherence and e0. The proved affine_singlePushforward_unit_isIso makes the specified unit composite invertible, and asIso gives c with its required hom equation by reflexivity.
Apply degree-zero finite-duality counit/action compatibility to the constructed M, e0 and canonical c. Obtain e, epsilon, its derived counit equation, evaluation at one and the precomposition action.
Apply the action formula with b=1, reverse it and simplify a*1=a using mul_one. Assemble the existential witnesses and all conjunctions.

split_report.summary: Repaired the returned split by deleting the two relabelling nodes and creating one canonical finite-duality statement that includes the counit evaluation at the unit. Added separate statement-only nodes for affine derived concentration and derived Hom from a finite locally free sheaf. The proof now derives finite-flat local freeness, degree-zero Hom, affine concentration, and the elementary module-linearity identity without treating an arbitrary isomorphism as canonical.
split_report.blueprint: Realizes the finite-flat duality proof dependency of lem-sc-finite-duality, including the degree-zero, counit, and evaluation clauses.

tool_uses.why: The affine algebra fact that finite type over a Noetherian ring is finitely presented supplies the local finite presentation needed in the finite-flat criterion.
